results.text: We chose PostgreSQL for billing because of LSN-based replication guarantees.
Sibyl listens on neo4j port 7689 and redis port 6389 locally (overrides 7687/6379 defaults).
Pre-commit hook fails on Python files with mismatched mypy stubs — run `uv pip install --upgrade types-redis` first.
Plan 15 gold sets live in tests/fixtures/gold/ and regenerate via `make goldset`.
Background workers are gated by SIBYL_GPU_CONCURRENCY; on CPU dev boxes leave at 4.
